data.topic: Fix memory/correction pipeline bugs from AUDIT.md: BUG-5, BUG-6, BUG-10, BUG-11, R-7, CQ-6, CQ-10

findings.summary: om_write() is the canonical gate for all OpenMemory writes — validates tags, dedup, budgets
findings.details: om_write(content, tags, user_id, sector, salience, decay_lambda) enforces ALLOWED_TAGS whitelist, 0.85 cosine similarity dedup, per-tag budget limits. Default feedback_score is the salience parameter (0.5). All writes must route through this function.

findings.summary: signal_processor.py owns all correction detection logic (decision-43, decision-75)
findings.details: process_session_corrections() is the single entry point. Shell hooks call Python. stop_processor stages should delegate to signal_processor, not duplicate logic.

findings.summary: decision-104 already decided: route _om_shadow_decision through om_write()
findings.details: Fixes both dedup bypass (BUG-6) and immediate pruning (BUG-11). om_write() sets feedback_score=0.5 by default. Requires MCP server sys.path to include project root for import.

findings.summary: decision-103 decided fcntl.flock for stop_processor lockfile (not in scope but adjacent)
findings.details: Advisory locking, auto-releases on crash. Rejected O_CREAT|O_EXCL due to stale lock risk.

findings.summary: stop_processor has 3 stages: correction_detection, signal_processing, distillation
findings.details: Stage 1 (line 82) calls process_session_corrections(). Stage 2 (line 145) calls it AGAIN — this is R-7. Stage 2 should only run signal/preference updates, not re-detect corrections.

findings.summary: project_root computed via dirname chain from db_file path
findings.details: db_file = ~/.claude/.claude/epics.db. 3 dirname calls → ~ (HOME). Should be 2 dirname calls → ~/.claude. Found at signal_processor.py:388, signal_processor.py:732, stop_processor.py:144.

findings.summary: enforce_budget() deletes oldest entries then returns — caller does INSERT separately
findings.details: Lines 84-126 in om_write.py. No transaction boundary wrapping delete+insert. Crash between delete and insert loses entries permanently.

findings.summary: _compute_simhash uses MD5 hex truncation, not actual SimHash
findings.details: hashlib.md5(content.lower().strip().encode()).hexdigest()[:16]. Used as embedding fallback. Name misleads maintainers expecting near-duplicate detection.

findings.summary: No unit tests exist for om_write.py, signal_processor.py, or stop_processor.py
findings.details: Only test_merge_gate.py and test_init_run_db.py exist. pytest framework with tmp_path fixtures and real subprocess calls (no mocking).

decisions_relevant.summary: Shadow decision writes route through om_write() instead of direct INSERT
decisions_relevant.impact: Directly resolves BUG-6 approach — use om_write() not direct INSERT. Also fixes BUG-11 since om_write sets feedback_score=0.5

decisions_relevant.summary: Correction detection single source of truth in signal_processor.py
decisions_relevant.impact: Confirms R-7 fix direction — stop_processor should not re-run correction detection

decisions_relevant.summary: Correction pipeline unified into signal_processor.py process_session_corrections()
decisions_relevant.impact: Supports CQ-6 — extract shared logic so stop_processor delegates rather than duplicates

decisions_relevant.summary: Reduce to 3 persistence surfaces (correction_groups DB, rendered-prefs.md, openmemory.sqlite)
decisions_relevant.impact: Context for why om_write correctness matters — it's one of only 3 persistence surfaces

decisions_relevant.summary: Lockfile strategy: fcntl.flock advisory locking for stop_processor
decisions_relevant.impact: Adjacent to BUG-3 (not in scope) — don't contradict this decision

runtime_contracts: om_write(content, tags, user_id, sector, salience, decay_lambda) → id or None
blast_radius.failure_symptoms: If om_write breaks: all OpenMemory writes fail silently (stderr only). Decision shadows, tool learnings, session summaries stop persisting. Dedup/budget may allow unbounded growth.
If stop_processor breaks: corrections not detected, preferences not updated, session learning stops. Runs async so failures are silent.
If signal_processor breaks: correction counts wrong, auto-distillation fails, preference scores not updated.

runtime_contracts: pm_add_decision MCP tool → shadows to OpenMemory
blast_radius.failure_symptoms: If tools_knowledge breaks: pm_add_decision tool errors out in MCP server. All decision recording fails.

gaps: No unit tests for any of the 4 write targets — correctness verified only by manual observation
prune_expired() caller not found in visible codebase — likely in session startup hook inline Python
No WAL mode on openmemory.sqlite (BUG-4, out of scope but adjacent)
